import re, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path('tests')
START = re.compile(r'\bassert(_eq|_ne)?!\s*\(')

def balanced_end(text, open_at):
    depth, i, in_str, escaped = 0, open_at, False, False
    while i < len(text):
        ch = text[i]
        if in_str:
            if escaped: escaped = False
            elif ch == '\\': escaped = True
            elif ch == '"': in_str = False
        elif ch == '"': in_str = True
        elif ch == '(': depth += 1
        elif ch == ')':
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0: return i + 1
        i += 1
    return len(text)

files = sites = 0
for path in sorted(root.rglob('*.rs')):
    text = path.read_text()
    if 'stderr=' not in text or 'diagnostics' not in text:
        continue
    out, pos = [], 0
    while True:
        m = START.search(text, pos)
        if m is None:
            out.append(text[pos:]); break
        end = balanced_end(text, m.end() - 1)
        block = text[m.start():end]
        # Rename the LABEL only where the value printed is the diagnostic stream, and only when
        # stderr is not also read in the same assertion — otherwise the label would lie the
        # other way round.
        if '.diagnostics' in block and '.stderr' not in block:
            fixed = block.replace('stderr={}', 'diagnostics={}').replace('got stderr=', 'got diagnostics=')
            if fixed != block:
                sites += 1
            block = fixed
        out.append(text[pos:m.start()]); out.append(block); pos = end
    new_text = ''.join(out)
    if new_text != text:
        path.write_text(new_text); files += 1
print(f"relabelled {sites} assertions across {files} files")
